covers: Every add form from an empty registry: stdio with ~ expansion in command and args, env flags after the name with non-string values, http, sse with static headers, add-json for a headersHelper; _ entries and a profile-gated entry on a machine without a ralph config are skipped.
deviation: --header flags go after the name and url. The script put them first, where the variadic --header swallows the name, so claude rejected the add (missing required argument 'name').
